entries.original: TUI controls now support F13-F24 keybindings, paste in searchable menus, and a compact reasoning-only status/title item (#25329, #25400, #25504).
entries.translated: [codex] 제안을 위한 원격 플러그인 카탈로그 캐싱

entries.original: Enterprise/admin flows now show monthly credit limits and can apply cloud-managed config bundles, including EDU workspaces (#24812, #24617, #24619, #24620, #24622, #25963).
entries.translated: [codex] 플러그인 탐색 로직을 core-plugins로 이동

entries.original: Remote-control clients can start pairing and list or revoke controller grants through app-server v2 RPCs (#25675, #25785).
entries.translated: [codex] 플러그인 스킬 기본 이름 검증

entries.original: Plugin workflows gained machine-readable `codex plugin list --json` output and cached remote catalog suggestions (#25330, #25457).
entries.translated: 압축된 롤아웃 검색 스니펫 재사용

entries.original: Hosted web and image tools are available in more code-mode flows, with standalone web searches able to run in parallel (#25176, #25702, #25890, #25923).
entries.translated: 멀티 에이전트 런타임 메타데이터 타입 추가

entries.original: Multi-agent v2 keeps runtime choice with each thread and exposes cleaner follow-up and metadata defaults for spawned agents (#25266, #25636, #25720, #25721, #25722, #25841, #26114).
entries.translated: 멀티 에이전트 런타임 메타데이터 영속화

entries.original: Cancelling a submitted prompt before visible output now restores the draft, attachments, and collaboration mode for editing (#25316).
entries.translated: 스레드별 멀티 에이전트 런타임 확인

entries.original: Slash-command filtering and footer shortcut hints now reset or render according to the current UI state (#25492, #25625).
entries.translated: Session: 시작 시 프리웜(prewarm)을 확인된 멀티 에이전트 런타임과 일치하도록 유지

entries.original: Platform reliability improved for macOS app launches and Windows SQLite startup, thread resume, and sandbox setup refreshes (#25485, #25490, #25509, #25949).
entries.translated: 메인 오류 수정

entries.original: Plugin loading preserves app manifest order, deduplicates local/remote curated installs, and treats malformed `skills` fields as warnings (#25491, #25681, #25717, #25782).
entries.translated: 원격 멀티 에이전트 런타임 셀렉터 오버라이드 테스트

entries.original: Permission requests and approvals now carry environment identity, and managed MITM proxying exports readable CA bundles to child commands (#25850, #25858, #25862, #22668).
entries.translated: 첫 번째 턴 이전의 런타임 셀렉터 테스트

entries.original: Local session history is safer for compressed rollouts, renamed titles, pathless side-chat reloads, and stack-heavy startup/config rebuilds (#25087, #25624, #25661, #25814, #25844, #25847).
entries.translated: 세션 시작 및 설정 재빌드 시 스택 부하 감소

entries.original: Added app-server docs and generated schema updates for monthly credit limits, remote-control RPCs, and environment-scoped permission approvals (#24812, #25675, #25785, #25862).
entries.translated: Flake: 플러그인 테스트 홈 유지

entries.original: Moved repo review rules and contributor conventions into `AGENTS.md`, including Rust test-module layout and Python 3 compatibility guidance (#25682, #25690, #25738).
Root formatting and Justfile workflows are more complete and Windows-aware (#24983, #25165, #25683).
entries.translated: Root formatting and Justfile workflows are more complete and Windows-aware (#24983, #25165, #25683).

entries.original: Rust CI and release workflows use the git CLI for Cargo fetches to avoid intermittent libgit2/submodule failures (#25644, #25775).
entries.translated: Rust CI and release workflows use the git CLI for Cargo fetches to avoid intermittent libgit2/submodule failures (#25644, #25775).

entries.original: Python SDK releases now publish runtime wheels from the SDK workflow and pin to a glibc-compatible runtime package (#25906, #25907).
entries.translated: Python SDK releases now publish runtime wheels from the SDK workflow and pin to a glibc-compatible runtime package (#25906, #25907).
